Join one of the featured servers. Look for Mineville or Lifeboat first; The Hive, Galaxite or Enchanted also work. The list on your screen may look different or be in a different order; any of those five opens the same menu. CubeCraft does not work for this

Leave the address as it is (the new short wrv.duckdns.org and the older addresses all work). Change only the Port to 25622 , then Save.

title: The Five Seals: the Road to the Guild
text:
The Five Seals: the Road to the Guild
Long ago, in the days of the Adventurers Guild, magic flowed free through the valley. It fed everything it touched: the fields, the tools in a farmer's hands, and the monsters in the dark. Fed on magic, the monsters of that age were far stronger than the ones you know today.
Read the whole story: the five keys and what each seal opens
That age ended. The world was sealed. Magic drained away, the guild's door was locked, and the monsters shrank to the shadows you fight now. But seals do not hold forever. Magic is seeping back into the valley, and the Old Quartermaster's warning stands over everything below: the magic returning now is stronger than the magic of his era .
The Old Quartermaster served the guild in those days. He stands in the spawn village today, an old man by a lectern of tales, because he remembers how this story goes. Five seals hold the guild. Each one falls to a family victory, and progress is shared: a victory earned by anyone counts for everyone. As each seal falls, more magic returns to the world — spells the family can cast, and strength in the wild things. That is the bargain of the road: every door you open, opens for the monsters too.
The valley today: 1 of 5 seals broken
The guild is LOCKED. The Adventurers Guild hall stands built but sealed. The guild button and /ag show the quest page instead, and /seals in game shows what remains.
Magic is awake. Seal 1 broke on October 23, 2026, at about 5:46 PM Central, when the family won a raid under Bad Omen V. The Healer's school of supportive magic is open: get your first wand from the Old Quartermaster in the spawn village.
Night has come back. The valley's long day ended on October 18: the sun rises and sets again, and the dark belongs to the monsters once more. Plan your exploring around the night.
The wild has an edge. About 7 of every 100 wild monsters rise as elites, and they feel like the Quartermaster's stories: since the Seal 1 step went in on October 25, 2026, they hit about 75% harder than normal (it was about 60% before), and they take about 45% less damage from your weapons — every hit lands at about 55% of its usual strength. An elite is matched to the strength of the player it fights, so every fight is winnable — and running away is always allowed. Only wild, natural monsters can rise as elites; spawner and farm mobs never do.
The Quartermaster is waiting. Tap him in the spawn village and he tells his tales, one at a time. He speaks them aloud now, in Briggs's voice: in a dialogue box on phones, iPads, tablets and consoles, and on computers too, once you accept the small voice pack the game offers. Since the first seal fell, he is the one who hands out the first wands.
The five keys
The seals fall to five great victories. They can be won in any order: the first victory breaks Seal 1, the second breaks Seal 2, and so on, whichever they are. How each fight goes is for the family to learn by facing it. Here is where each one waits and how to start it.
The Ender Dragon
She waits in the End. Find a stronghold, fill the End portal frame with eyes of ender, and step through.
The Wither
You summon it yourself: four soul sand in a T shape with three wither skeleton skulls on top. Skulls drop from wither skeletons in Nether fortresses.
The Elder Guardians
They live deep inside an ocean monument. Find a monument in a deep ocean and go in.
The Warden
It sleeps in the Deep Dark, around the ancient cities far underground. The sculk shriekers there call it up.
A Raid Victory
Drink an ominous bottle of Bad Omen V, the strongest omen, then walk into a village. That starts the raid that counts for this seal.
What each seal releases
Every fallen seal changes the world twice: once for the family, and once for the wild. Tap a seal to see both halves.
Seal 1 · Magic Wakes Broken October 23, 2026, about 5:46 PM Central (raid victory under Bad Omen V)
For the family: the first magic returns. The Old Quartermaster hands out the first wands in the village, and the Healer's school of supportive magic opens: 43 spells in the world, including the healer's kit (Mend, Flash Heal, Ward and Greater Heal, added October 24, 2026) and Storm Shackle, a chaining lightning spell made just for this valley. Full spell list: the Magic skill tree .
For the wild: the returning magic feeds the monsters too, and this half arrived early: elites already rose about 7 of every 100 wild spawns before the first seal fell. Now that this seal has fallen, elites hit harder still: about 75% above normal.
Seal 2 · The Pathfinder Sealed · breaks with the family's second victory
For the family: the Pathfinder's school opens and the spellbook grows to 81 spells: travel, finding, and getting home again.
For the wild: elites rise about 8 of every 100 wild spawns and hit about 90% harder than normal, and your hits land softer on them, at about 50% of their usual strength. Today, with Seal 1 broken, elites hit about 75% harder (that step went in on October 25, 2026), so Seal 2 is the next step up.
Seal 3 · The Wonder Sealed · breaks with the family's third victory
For the family: the Wonder school opens and the spellbook grows to 142 spells, the strangest and showiest magic of the road.
For the wild: both halves move. Elites rise about 9 of every 100 wild spawns, and elite damage rises to about 105% above normal; elites stand longer against you too: your hits land at about 50% of their usual strength.
Seal 4 · The Masons Sealed · breaks with the family's fourth victory
For the family: the Masons' building magic opens, 142 spells in the world. The Masons start with a small group of trusted builders, because a spell that conjures buildings needs careful hands; their conjured blocks are temporary and respect land claims. At Seal 5 the Masons join every mage.
For the wild: the hardest nights yet. Elites rise about 10 of every 100 wild spawns and hit about 120% harder than normal, and your hits land at about 45% of their usual strength.
Seal 5 · The Guild Opens Sealed · breaks with the family's fifth and final victory
For the family: the last seal falls and the Adventurers Guild opens its doors: /ag to the guild hall, its own world of NPCs, shops, quests, and arenas like the Wood League. The spellbook completes at 203 spells, and the Masons' magic joins every mage.

title: The Phantom Debt: why phantoms are back
text:
The Phantom Debt: why phantoms are back
Phantoms are back. While the Ender Dragon lives, phantoms return to the valley on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday nights. Friday, Saturday and Sunday nights are safe: no phantoms come on weekends. This is the Phantom Debt, and it repeats every week until the dragon falls. The Phantom Debt is live now: it began on the evening of October 18, 2026 (ExcelNoPhantoms 1.2.0, event mode). The first haunted night was Monday, October 19, 2026.
Read more about the Phantom Debt
Why are phantoms back? What is the Phantom Debt? The valley owes a debt for its long, safe days. While the dragon lives, her nightmares leak into the sky, and the phantoms ride them down on haunted nights: Monday night, Tuesday night, Wednesday night and Thursday night. The guild's powers are trying to protect the valley, and their wards hold on Friday, Saturday and Sunday — that is why weekends are safe. But the wards are not strong enough to hold all week, so the debt comes due again every Monday night.
When do phantoms come? Phantoms come at night on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday. Are there phantoms tonight? If tonight is a Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday or Thursday night, yes: it is a haunted night, and a warning goes out at dusk on haunted evenings so nobody is caught by surprise. On the night before the first haunted night, every player who joined the server was greeted with the warning in chat, so nobody missed the story. If tonight is Friday, Saturday or Sunday, sleep easy: the valley is safe and no phantoms come.
Phantom rules are the vanilla rules. Phantoms hunt players who have not slept in days: the longer you go without sleeping, the more phantoms come for you. Sleeping is the shield. Sleep in a bed and sleeping resets your sleepless nights, and the phantoms leave you alone. How do I stop phantoms? Sleep. Sleeping stops phantoms from hunting you, every time. Sleeping is how you keep phantoms away: a player who sleeps is a player the phantoms cannot hunt.
On haunted nights the sky tells the story itself, in chat, a line at a time through the night: the Long Day debt, the dragon's nightmares, the wards failing on haunted nights and holding on weekends, and sleep as the shield. Why does the sky talk at night? The sky talks because it is repeating the reason, so nobody forgets why the phantoms are back. What are the messages in chat at night? Those chat messages are the sky's own messages, not player messages: the sky retelling the Phantom Debt story, one message at a time. Read the messages in chat and you hear the whole reason. If you want to hear why, just stay up on a haunted night and listen.
When do the phantoms stop? When does the Phantom Debt end? The Phantom Debt ends for good when the Ender Dragon falls. The dragon has her own seal: defeat the Ender Dragon and the debt is paid, the nightmares end, and phantoms go back to being turned off every night, forever. Until that family victory, the cycle repeats: haunted Monday to Thursday nights, safe weekends, and sleep as your shield.

title: First, what is a command?
text:
First, what is a command?
A command is a short message you type in the chat box. It always starts with a slash, like this: /spawn
To open the chat box on a computer, press the T key. On a phone, iPad or tablet, tap the speech bubble at the top of the screen. On a console, press right on the D-pad. Type the command and press Enter or Send.
When you see something in pointy brackets, like <name> , swap it for the real thing. So /tpa <name> becomes /tpa Grandma . Don't type the brackets.

title: The Valley Guide: answers in game chat
text:
The Valley Guide: answers in game chat
The Valley Guide is the server's in-game helper (ExcelGuide 0.2.3, live October 19, 2026). The Guide answers questions in chat using this website's own knowledge, the same pages the "Ask the site" button reads.
Three ways to ask the Guide: type /ask and your question, start a chat message with “Guide,”, or ask about the server in ordinary chat and the Guide may answer. The Guide knows joining, the five seals, shops, claims, skills, and your own stats (it only ever tells you your own). When the Guide does not know, it says so instead of guessing, and the question is logged so its knowledge can grow.
The Guide can think now. Ask a question its cards do not cover and it composes a real answer on the spot, out of the valley's own knowledge, wording the answer for your question instead of reading a card aloud. It is a small AI that has only ever been taught this valley: this website's knowledge, and nothing else. Ask about yourself and the Guide answers with your real numbers, pulled from the server itself: your claim blocks, your skills, your balance. Ask who leads a board and it points you to the leaderboard first, and names who is on top. And the Guide learns. When it works out a good answer, it remembers that answer: ask the same question again and the Guide answers instantly, from what it learned, without having to think it through twice. Answers the family asks for again and again can be made permanent, so the Guide keeps getting smarter the more the valley talks to it. Does the Guide use AI? Yes: the Guide has an AI now, a small AI taught only this valley. The Guide uses that AI to answer from the valley's own knowledge, and it uses nothing else. If it truly does not know, it still says so instead of guessing, and the question is logged so its knowledge can grow.
New in 0.2.3: the Guide answers claim questions properly. Ask how many claim blocks you have and it answers with your own numbers, explains the rule, and points you to /claimslist to see them. The Guide never meets a direct question with silence, either: if an answer needs a moment, or a short wait applies, it tells you so and names the wait. And the Guide learns from the family now. When it does not know something and a player answers in chat, the Guide remembers that answer and serves it later with the credit attached, naming the player who figured it out. If two answers disagree, the Guide weighs them against this website's knowledge and what other players confirm; the answer that holds up is the one that gets learned, and anything it cannot settle is saved for Mike's weekly review.
Type /guide off if you do not want the Guide listening.

title: How to use your wand
text:
How to use your wand
Your first wand from the Old Quartermaster knows Healer spells: Heal, Boon, Feed, Extinguish and Aqualung. Cure comes later when you rank up to Student. (Wand controls updated October 23, 2026 so phones, tablets and controllers can switch spells fast, even in a fight.)
Java (mouse and keyboard)
Cast: left-click.
Next spell: right-click. It switches right away, no menu.
Spell list: sneak (Shift) and right-click, then click a spell.
Back one spell: press Q.
See your spell: its name shows above your hotbar and on the wand.
Bedrock touch (phone or tablet)
Cast: tap the air or a mob.
Next spell: press and hold on the screen. It switches right away.
Spell list: crouch, then press and hold. Tap a spell.
See your spell: its name shows above your hotbar.
Tip: if press and hold breaks a block, look at the sky first.
Bedrock controller (Xbox, also on iPad)
Cast: press RT (right trigger).
Next spell: press LT (left trigger). It switches right away.
Spell list: crouch (press the right stick) and press LT. Move to a spell and press A.
See your spell: its name shows above your hotbar.
Pick your controls: /wandstyle (new October 24, 2026, more styles October 25). The steps above are the Classic controls, and everyone starts on Classic. Type /wandstyle to pick a style: Classic , Sneak bars (phones and consoles: right-click opens your spell bar and a sneak press flips to the next bar), Cycle (step to the next spell), Tap to cycle (tap a spell icon to pick it, then press and hold to cast) or Tap bar (best on a phone: tap your wand and your hotbar turns into spell icons, tap an icon to cast it, press and hold to read that spell's page, and tap an empty slot to get your items back). On a phone or console, /wandstyle opens a screen with one button per style, and the Spell Book has a Wand controls button at the bottom. Your choice is saved and comes back when you rejoin, respawn or get a new wand.
Spells use mana. Wait a few seconds if a spell will not cast. The wand is bound to you, so you can't lose it.
How do I switch spells on my wand? How do I use the wand on a phone, iPad or controller? Right-click (Java), press and hold (touch) or press LT (controller) to jump to the next spell right away. Crouch and do the same to open the full spell list. Why can't I switch spells? Use the steps above instead of the hotbar.

title: Your gear explains itself
text:
Your gear explains itself
New: your gear explains itself. Every enchanted item carries a short block under its own text saying what each of its enchantments does at that item's level, with the real numbers, and weapons also show their true total hit. The green 'Attack Damage' line still shows the item's base damage only — that's how the game draws it, not a bug: Sharpness adds its damage inside the hit itself (a Sharpness 5 diamond sword reads 7 there but hits for 10). Old gear picks up its explanation the next time you handle it; enchanting, the anvil and the grindstone keep it current.
Why does my sword say 7 attack damage? The green Attack Damage line shows the item's base damage only — that is how the game draws it, not a bug. Enchantments like Sharpness add their damage inside the hit itself, so a Sharpness 5 diamond sword reads 7 there but hits for 10. What does Sharpness do? Every level adds damage to each hit: a Sharpness 5 sword adds 3 damage on top of the sword's own. What do my enchantments do? Read the short block under the item's own text — ExcelItemInsight lists every enchantment on the item with what it does at that item's level and the real numbers. How much damage does my sword really do? Weapons show their true total hit in that block, base damage plus Sharpness, so the number you read is the number you hit for.

title: How to use an active ability
text:
How to use an active ability
Reach the required level and hold the right tool.
Use/right-click the tool to ready it. On a phone, iPad, tablet or controller, use your control scheme's Use / Interact action.
Within 4 seconds , do the matching action: mine, chop, dig, harvest, or hit a target.
Watch for the ability message. After the boost ends, most active abilities have a 4-minute base cooldown . Blast Mining has its own activation and a 1-minute cooldown .
The usual level-50 boosts start at about 3 seconds, grow to 12 seconds at level 500, and reach 22 seconds at level 1000. Player perks can change the timing.

title: Nothing happened?
text:
Nothing happened?
Check your level with the skill command and your timer with /mccooldown . Make sure you're using the right tool and target. With something in your off-hand, try sneaking while you ready the tool. /mcability toggles ability activation, so check its message instead of repeatedly switching it.
Touch controls differ by Minecraft control scheme. A long press is not the same action on every phone, iPad or tablet.
Keep family builds safe. Tree Feller can take down connected logs, and Blast Mining explodes immediately. Practice far from homes, animals, and other players. Repair may remove enchantments; Salvage destroys the item.

title: Play together in a party
text:
Play together in a party
A party is a little team. Use Minecraft account names in commands, which can be different from display nicknames.
One person types /party create Family (or chooses another team name).
Invite someone with /party invite PlayerName .
The invited player types /party accept .
Check /party info together. Use /party quit to leave.

How XP sharing works at party level 10
The party leader can use /party xpshare equal to share, or /party xpshare none to stop. Eligible teammates within 75 blocks share the earned skill XP pool.
With the checked settings, 100 earned XP shared by two nearby teammates becomes a 150-XP pool: 75 each , before individual modifiers. Sharing helps everyone progress together, but does not mean each player gets 150 XP.

title: Read the bonus bar
text:
Read the bonus bar
A separate bonus bar appears after positive accepted skill XP or eligible green-bar XP. It hides three seconds after your latest gain ; earning more XP extends the same bar. Joining, standing still, or checking status does not open it. Server lag can stretch the three-second timer. ×1.00 means the base bonus factor. If skill XP and green-bar XP have different factors, it shows them separately. Restrictions or unavailable green-bar support are labeled instead of promising a reward.
/xpbonus or /xpbonus status shows your current factors, skill-specific rates, and relevant restrictions
/xpbonus hide disables future notifications and hides the current bar without turning off your XP rewards
/xpbonus show enables future brief notifications; earn eligible XP to see the next one
/xpbonus toggle switches future notifications on or off
Temporary indicator installed October 12: the three-second setting and startup were verified. The server owner personally tested it on October 12 and reported that it worked. The installed name of the weekend add-on is now ExcelWeekendXP (it was WeekendXP until October 16, 2026), and mcMMO keeps its name; the original mcMMO is by nossr50 and the mcMMO Team , who keep full credit for it.
Your shown/hidden preference is saved for later joins. If a factor is unexpected, check that your teammate is in the same party and world, is close enough, and that the status command does not show a permission or area restriction.
Which green-bar XP counts?
The bonus applies to eligible, positive XP-orb pickups after Mending . It boosts the points left for your green bar, not Mending repairs. Normal identified gameplay sources include mining, mob drops, fishing, furnace output, breeding, trading, bottles o' enchanting, and grindstones.
Direct command/API and advancement XP grants do not pass through this pickup bonus. Identified player-death refunds and unmarked custom or unknown orbs are excluded. Tiny fractional bonuses carry forward across eligible pickups instead of being lost.
Other plugins and merged XP orbs can affect source identification. This is not a guarantee that every refunded or custom orb can be distinguished. The owner-reported indicator pass does not verify every XP source, reward amount, or Java/Bedrock client; those checks remain open.

title: Claim blocks: how much land you can claim
text:
Claim blocks: how much land you can claim
The short version: claiming land is how you protect your stuff: inside your claims, nobody else can break blocks, open chests or take your things unless you trust them. Claiming spends claim blocks , and claim blocks are your land allowance. Every player starts with 100 claim blocks.
How you get more claim blocks: just play. You earn 100 claim blocks for every hour you are on the server, and the ones you earn from playing can build up to 80,000 at most. Claim blocks are never sold on this server: playing is the only way to get more.
Your first claim is automatic: the first chest you place claims a small patch of land around it (9 blocks across) so your starter things are safe. After that first chest, you claim land yourself.
How to claim land by hand: hold a golden shovel, right-click (or tap) one corner of the land, then the opposite corner. A claim has to cover at least 100 blocks of land. You can also type /claim to claim a patch of land around where you are standing.
How to check your claim blocks: you can check your own numbers any time. Type /claimslist to see all your claimed land. To see the numbers, open /leaderboard and pick Land Claimed : it shows how many blocks everyone has claimed and how many claim blocks they can still claim, including you.
Letting family in: /trust <name> lets someone build inside your claims, and /untrust <name> takes that back. The land stays yours either way.
Giving land back: stand inside a claim you don't want anymore and type /abandonclaim to give up just that one claim - that is how you delete a claim. To abandon all your claims at once, type /abandonallclaims . Either way you get all of that claim's blocks back, ready to spend on new land. The claim just stops protecting the land: anything you built there stays put, and when you delete a claim your buildings do not move. Want to try a different spot? You might claim the wrong corner now and then - abandon it and try again somewhere better. Nothing is lost by giving land back.

The Adventurer's Guild hall stands built, but it is sealed: type /ag anywhere and, while any of the five seals stands (1 of 5 broken today), you get the guild quest page instead of the hall. The hall itself — a separate world of NPC shops, guides and portals to adventures — opens when the fifth seal falls. When it does, talk to Hermes the transporter to leave, and stand perfectly still until you land — those teleports count down over a few seconds and cancel if you move. The stronger elite monsters you meet while exploring are still the everyday challenge. When an elite drops its coin shower, those coins are real dollars added to your normal balance, and higher-level elites pay more. Since October 21, 2026 the showers pay double what they paid before, so an elite hunt is worth noticeably more than it was. And in the Nether fortress, an elite wither skeleton beaten by a player drops its skull about 1 time in 4 — far oftener than an ordinary wither skeleton — so the surest road to the three skulls a Wither needs is hunting the elite ones. Ordinary wither skeletons keep the usual rare chance. Since the October 20, 2026 update (EliteMobs 10.9.10), the EliteMobs menus work better on phones, tablets and consoles: your /em status, quests and classes now open as proper dialog screens instead of inventory grids. Menus on a computer look the same as before, and shop screens stay inventory-style on every device. The setting is switched on and verified in the server’s own configuration; a first check of the new screens on a real phone is still to come.
Excel Party Drops: Hunting together pays off. When a tough elite monster falls, everyone in the fight nearby shares a fuller pile of drops — the more of the family in range when it falls (within about 50 blocks), the more drops, up to three times as many. Solo hunts pay exactly as before.
Watch the charge (our own add-on, ExcelZombieCharge): Hit a zombie, a husk, a drowned or a zombie villager — babies included — or a piglin with an arrow, a thrown trident or a magic spell, and it charges: half again as fast for about 3 seconds, and every new ranged hit refreshes the rush. A hit up close with a sword never provokes it. Sniping from a safe perch is what brings them running; standing your ground does not.
Tip: A higher-level monster is tougher. Bring good gear, or bring family.

The custom add-on is now named ExcelShops . It runs the player shops (also called chest shops): shops you stock yourself so you can sell items to other players. Selling to other players: stock a chest inside your claimed land, attach an ordinary sign, set your prices, and confirm publication. Other players browse your player shop, review their purchase, and tap Confirm; the money goes straight to your balance. You can sell almost any stuff you can stock: food, blocks, tools and enchanted books. Restock from the same screens when other players buy your stuff. Unrelated trading systems are separate; this guide does not claim that every possible server purchase route was player-tested.
Buy from an Excel shop chest
Open a chest labeled [Excel Shop] , or use its sign. Old managed [WRV Shop] labels also work. The browsing screen is read-only.
Choose an item and how many you want. On a Bedrock phone, enter a whole number in the form. On Java, choose Enter Amount to type an exact whole number, then Use amount; plus/minus buttons remain available. See the typed-entry guide below.
Review the item, quantity, unit price, and total. Check enchantments and custom item details too.
Choose Confirm purchase once on the separate final confirmation screen. Back, Cancel, closing the menu, or disconnecting before confirmation does not buy anything.
Stay within six blocks. Quotes normally expire after 60 seconds. Changed prices or stock need a fresh review; insufficient money or inventory room prevents the purchase. If phone forms are unavailable, the inventory buttons are used. A recovery warning means stop and ask Mike, rather than repeatedly retrying.
Make your own Excel shop
Place your own single normal or trapped chest in a land claim you own. Put your sale items inside. Both the chest and its sign must be in your claims; being trusted in someone else's claim is not ownership.
Sneak while placing an ordinary wall sign against the chest, or a standing sign on top. Finish the normal sign editor. No special sign syntax is needed.

title: Veil Potion: farm while standard mobs ignore you
text:
Veil Potion: farm while standard mobs ignore you
ExcelMobVeil 0.1.0 is installed, October 13, 2026. The exact plugin, $2,000 price and new shop entry were verified after restart. Real Java/Bedrock screens, live purchases and the full live plugin combination remain unverified.
Veil Potion — $2,000 in-game money: open your compass menu → Spawn Shop → Potions & Protection → Veil Potion. Review the price, balance and money left or shortfall, then use the separate Confirm button to buy one stored potion. Opening the review, repeating the buy command, going Back or closing it does not buy anything. Buying or carrying it does not activate the veil; drink it first. You can also use /veil buy .
Every drink adds eight real-time minutes to whatever time remains. Two fresh drinks give about sixteen minutes. Use /veil status to check your remaining time. Time keeps running while you are offline and through ordinary server restarts.
Your body becomes invisible and standard mobs ignore you, even in armor . Other players can still see your armor and held items. Harvesting, planting, tilling, chopping, mining and air swings keep the effect. Passive Thorns retaliation also keeps it.
Attacking ends all accumulated time. Hitting an animal, mob, player or other entity, firing an offensive projectile, or supported damage attributed to you reveals you. Milk, death, expiry or another effect removing/replacing invisibility also ends it. Another ordinary invisibility effect can block drinking a Veil Potion; wait for it to end. Do not brew Veil Potions: brewing removes their custom properties.
This is not invulnerability. Existing projectiles, explosions, collisions, environmental hazards and area attacks can still hurt you. Bosses, EliteMobs custom scripts, custom AI and other plugins are outside the first-version targeting guarantee and may behave differently. This is separate from Death Protection.

title: Death Protection: two ways to keep your items through one death
text:
Death Protection: two ways to keep your items through one death
ExcelDeathProtection 0.1.3 is installed, October 13, 2026. The new one-item purchase review is intended to make your balance and exact shortfall easier to see. The remaining Java and Bedrock-phone review-window checks, real purchases and gameplay acceptance for 0.1.3 were waived by the server owner on October 13, 2026; they are recorded as unverified, not passed. Startup and automated tests do not prove the in-game experience. The earlier 0.1.2 phone check covered shop-entry appearance only.
Death Protection — $15,000: protection starts immediately after you confirm the purchase. You receive no item and have no potion to drink. This option gives no extra powers or potion effects. A bar reading Inventory protected: 1 death indicates basic protection.
+Death Protection Potion — $30,000: buy a potion to store and drink later. Buying it does not activate protection; drink it first. While premium protection is active, it also gives Conduit Power: underwater breathing, clearer underwater vision, and faster mining. The mining boost also works on land. Its blue shell icon can come from other sources too, so use /dp status to check your protection.
How to buy: open Spawn Shop → Potions & Protection and choose either option. A review window opens with quantity fixed at 1 , the product, price, your available balance and the money you would have left. If you cannot afford it, it shows Need $… more and disables purchasing. Prices use in-game money.
Only Confirm buys: select the enabled Confirm button to purchase one. Your current price, funds, eligibility and inventory space (for the potion) are checked again. Opening the review, repeating a buy command, refreshing, going Back or closing it never buys anything. Back to Spawn Shop cancels the review and returns to the shop.
Refresh when needed: the balance preview updates about once per second, but a review expires after 20 seconds. If it has expired, the price changed or it needs a new quote after you gained enough money, tap the disabled button to refresh the review, then use a separate Confirm. Refreshing itself does not charge you. The exact-shortfall display and Back navigation still need real phone/Java checks.
When you die: you still die and respawn normally, but you keep your inventory once. Neither option saves your XP; the server's normal XP rules still apply. That death uses up your protection. Active protection survives logging out and ordinary server restarts.
Only one active protection at a time: if either kind is active, buying basic protection is blocked before you are charged. Drinking another protection potion is also blocked, and you keep the potion. An undrunk potion in your inventory is not active protection.
Already protected, or have an older potion? Existing active protection and old Death Protection Potions stay premium, with no extra payment. Check your active tier at any time with /dp status .
You can also check or buy in chat: /deathprotection status shows what you hold; /deathprotection buy starts the same reviewed purchase.

title: Type exact shop amounts
text:
Type exact shop amounts
ExcelShops 1.1 is installed. The Java Enter Amount button lets you type a price or quantity in a private in-game text window. It does not send your text to public chat. Mike confirmed the Bedrock phone flow on October 14, 2026; Java display and input checks are still open.
Set a price: open your own chest/sign → Edit item prices → choose an item → Enter Amount. Type 0.50 for fifty cents per item, then choose Use amount . New shop setup uses the same field. Review the shop, then separately confirm publication.
Choose a quantity: On Java, use an item’s Enter Amount button, type a positive whole number such as 19 , then choose Use amount . On Bedrock, the Spawn Shop uses item details → Enter exact amount; submitting returns to that same item’s details. Continue with the buying walkthrough above . Player shops count individual items; Spawn Shop counts bundles where labeled. Check the final item count and total.
Prices accept 0.01 through 100000000.00 with up to two decimal places, without a dollar sign or commas. For example, 70000 is a valid price, but not a valid item quantity. Quantities are bounded by stock, bundle size, inventory capacity and a maximum of 2,304 delivered items. Zero, negative and invalid numbers are refused. Use the dialog’s Cancel button to keep the previous amount; Escape is disabled in this Java entry window. Invalid numbers show an explanation and let you try again. Java text entry expires after 60 seconds, and an old response cannot change a newly opened screen.
Bedrock keeps its native number forms. For player shops and the standalone fallback catalog, shared inventory buttons remain available instead of a Java-only dialog when a form cannot open. The Bedrock category-shop route instead closes safely if its native forms are unavailable. Java plus/minus buttons keep the in-place window update, and Java falls back to them if its native dialog API fails. Older translated Java clients still need a display check.

title: The Utility Pouch: a pocket for your server gear
text:
The Utility Pouch: a pocket for your server gear
The Utility Pouch (ExcelPouch 0.1.0, live October 19, 2026) is a small extra pocket that only holds server gear. Open it with /pouch , or tap the Utility Pouch button in the server menu: both the computer menu and the phone menu have the button now.
It has two pockets: one for your Server Menu compass, and one for your Magic wand, for when wands arrive at Seal 1: when yours comes, it goes in the wand pocket. Only your own bound wand fits the wand pocket, and nothing else goes in the pouch at all. It is not a backpack. The pouch keeps whatever you park in it until you take it out.
Parking your compass is easy: open the pouch, move the compass into the compass pocket, and close it — that is where your compass goes when you park it, and it stays there until you take it out. A parked compass stays out of your way: the server knows yours is parked, so it will not hand you a second one. Take it back out whenever you like. And what is parked stays parked through death: if you die with your compass parked, the pouch keeps it — die, respawn, and your pouch still holds exactly what you left in it.

title: Start a map normally
text:
Start a map normally
Get an ordinary empty map and use it to start mapping the area. No map-giving command is needed.
On a phone, hold it in your main hand. Java players can also hold it in their offhand.
Explore normally to fill in the terrain. The added names show eligible online players in the same world, including players beyond the map's terrain coverage.
Ordinary maps from before the original map-feature installation, explorer maps, and treasure maps are not automatically upgraded. Maps already enrolled with WRVPlayerMap keep tracking after the ExcelPlayerMap update. Custom maps are also skipped. The add-on does not give you free maps on join, death, or reconnect. Type /playermap for help.

title: What the names and arrows mean
text:
What the names and arrows mean
North is up. Your name and marker are green, with a * beside your name. Other players' names are yellow.
Inside the mapped area, arrows show which way a player is facing.
At the edge, arrows point from the map's center toward an out-of-area player. This may be a different direction from your own current position.
Lines connect labels to their real positions. When players stand together, the labels spread out to help you read them.
On a crowded map, some labels take turns being shown. Type /playermap list for the full text list of visible online players and their worlds.

title: A map of one area
text:
A map of one area
The map keeps its fixed, vanilla-aligned area. It does not follow or continuously recenter on you . Faraway unexplored terrain is not filled in automatically.

title: Use the normal cartography table
text:
Use the normal cartography table
Add paper to zoom out. The five normal scales cover 128, 256, 512, 1,024, and 2,048 blocks across. A larger area means less detail.
Add an empty map to make a copy. You can share maps with family; they are not owner-locked.
Add a glass pane to make a locked copy. That locked map stays plain, without the added live-player overlay. Use locked maps for walls and map art.
Zoomed maps keep Minecraft's normal exploration behavior. A held map and an unlocked framed copy with the same map ID can share rendered imagery, so an unlocked frame is not a separate, reliable live-player display.
Changing dimensions: the map remains a map of its original world. It does not switch to a different map when you travel through a portal. Players in another world are not placed at converted coordinates.

title: If something looks wrong
text:
If something looks wrong
No added names? Check that this is an unlocked, enrolled ordinary map and hold it in your hand. Previously enrolled WRVPlayerMap maps still qualify; older untracked and special maps keep their normal behavior.
A player is missing? They may be offline, in another world, or hidden from the added overlay by permissions or supported vanish settings. Use /playermap list to check. Minecraft's ordinary map cursors still follow its own rules.
The map is crowded? Labels cycle about every three seconds at the default update rate. Long or unsupported name characters may be shortened or shown as a question mark.
Lost a map? There is no automatic replacement. Keep a normal copy somewhere safe if you want one.
Player positions are sampled about once per second, with extra client/network delay possible. The basic player report does not verify phone/Java-specific readability, Geyser behavior, or live-server performance; those checks remain open.

Safety and restore
You cannot be hurt during a build session, so there is no dying in Builder Mode.
If you log out mid-flight, you rejoin in a protected landing hold (still flying, empty hands), and your Survival items return the moment you land.
Restore also runs on normal exit and on the recovery paths after a rejoin or a server restart, so a session cannot strand your Survival inventory.

Geyser, Floodgate, ViaVersion, ViaBackwards: Let phones, iPads, tablets, consoles, and computers all play together, even on different game versions.

Unlocks announce themselves. The moment you cross a perk's level, the game posts a clickable "[ mcMMO @ Skill Rank Unlocked!]" message in chat, with a sound, so you hear about new perks as you earn them. Level-ups show in the action bar and chat too.
Perks marked From the start have no unlock level at all: they work from your first day and quietly grow stronger as you level. That is why a bonus like Smelting's Second Smelt can feel like it appeared from nowhere. It was always on.
Good to know
Bonuses stack: Friday through Sunday, mcMMO and vanilla XP earn at 1.2x (ExcelWeekendXP), and playing near your party shares mcMMO XP (ExcelTogether).
Jobs pays cash for many of the same activities, but Jobs has no level perks of its own. Its only boost is the Jobs weekend bonus: 1.2x XP and money for all jobs, all day Friday, Saturday and Sunday (Friday added October 23, 2026).
Player-vs-player fighting is on, with two limits: party members can't hurt each other (ExcelTogether parties and mcMMO parties), and players can't hurt each other inside land claims (GriefPrevention). mcMMO has its skills switched on for PvP, so the PvP perks (Daze, Disarm, Iron Grip) work when you fight another player outside your party and outside a claim. Limit Breaks only add damage against other players, never against mobs.
Salvage is a child skill: it grows from your Repair and Fishing levels together.

title: Active since Seal 1 · 1 of 5 seals broken
text:
Active since Seal 1 · 1 of 5 seals broken
The Magic Skill Tree
Magic is active since Seal 1 : the seal broke on October 23, 2026, at about 5:46 PM Central, and the Healer's school opened (stage 1). Since October 24, 2026, about 2:05 AM Central, stage 1 has 43 spells in the world, including the healer's kit. Get your first wand from the Old Quartermaster. The Adventurers Guild itself stays locked, and as the family's remaining seals fall, magic seeps back into the valley one school at a time. The guild is at 1 of 5 seals today.
How magic will work
Every mage walks one path: Beginner, then Student, then Apprentice, then Master . Your mana pool grows along the way: 60, then 100, then 150, then 200.
You earn spell points (SP) by casting spells. Each spell pays out on its own cooldown, so repeating one spell cannot farm points; trying different spells is how you grow.
Each rank is paced at about two days of casual play . Playing more is fine; the tree just will not be rushed in an afternoon.
Spells unlock by learning them with SP once your rank is high enough. The costs below are the real planned costs.
Magic is built on the Magic plugin by NathanWolf (elMakers), configured by us for this server, with one spell of our own: Storm Shackle.
Magic went in dormant on purpose, with no player trial first (the owner's call on October 17, 2026), and stayed asleep until Seal 1 broke on October 23: the family becomes the test as each school opens. The seals decide when each school opens.
Combat Attunement
Active since Seal 1. ExcelAttunement went onto the server on October 20, 2026, ahead of the first wand, and switched on when Seal 1 broke on October 23. Now that the Old Quartermaster hands out wands, the rule below governs mixing weapons and spells.
Combat Attunement. Fighting commits you. Land a hit with a weapon — sword, axe, mace, trident, bow or crossbow — and for the next 30 seconds your wand goes quiet: no casting until the stance fades. Cast a fighting spell instead (or heal while you're in the middle of a fight) and your weapons go quiet for 30 seconds the same way. Healing or buffing BEFORE a fight is fine — that's just good preparation, and utility spells like Recall never lock you at all. Your stance and its countdown sit in the action bar above your hotbar, so you always know which side you're on and how long is left.
Stance lock (ExcelAttunement 0.1.5, live since October 24, 2026). After a combat spell you are in caster stance: your weapons stay locked for 30 seconds, and the bar above your hotbar counts down. After a weapon hit you are in fighter stance: your wand waits instead. Taking hits keeps your stance going.
Magic is off in the EliteMobs worlds. Magic is silent inside the Adventurers' Guild and the EliteMobs dungeons. Your wand stays a plain item there, and short Magic buffs fade at the door. Spells that would carry you into those worlds, like Recall, are turned aside. The guild's own classes and gear do the fighting. Magic works as before everywhere else in the valley.
The five seals
Each seal falls when the family earns any one of these victories, in any order: the Ender Dragon, the Wither, the Elder Guardians of an ocean monument, the Warden, or a raid victory. The first seal opens the first school below, the second seal the second school, and so on.

ExcelGuide Created by us 0.3.2 installed October 25, 2026, about 11:18 PM Central; 0.2.3 on October 19, 2026, about 7:24 AM Central Version 0.3.2 (installed October 25, 2026, about 11:18 PM Central) answers questions asked in ordinary chat. Ask a game question in chat and the Guide looks it up quietly, then waits about 45 seconds. If nobody answers, it posts an answer in public chat, drawn from this website, answers it has learned, and AI as a last resort. If another player answers first, the Guide stays out of it, and when the asker thanks them, that answer is remembered and reused the next time someone asks (shown as "A player said: ...", never with a name). Player answers have to match the question and look like a real answer before they are kept, so chatter is never learned. Public answers never show anyone's private details; questions about your own numbers get a private reply. Say "nvm" or "found it" to cancel a question. Its knowledge was refreshed from this website the same night. Tested on our test server; real family questions are its first live test. Version 0.2.3 gives the Guide three new habits. It answers claim questions with your own numbers: ask how many claim blocks you have and it tells you yours, with the rule and the /claimslist command to see them. It never leaves a direct question in silence: if an answer needs a few seconds, or a short wait applies, it says so and names the wait. And it learns from the family: when the Guide does not know something and a player answers in chat, the answer is remembered and served later with the credit attached, naming the player who figured it out. If two answers disagree, the Guide weighs them against this website's knowledge and what other players confirm; the answer that holds up is the one learned, and questions it cannot settle go to Mike's weekly review. Version 0.2.1 teaches the Guide to think. Questions with no scripted answer now get a composed answer drawn from this website's knowledge; questions about you are answered with your real numbers from the server itself; and good answers are remembered, so the next time the same question is asked the Guide answers instantly, from what it learned. Answers a human reviews can be promoted into permanent answers. The Valley Guide: an in-game helper who answers questions in chat, using this website's own knowledge. Type /ask followed by your question, start a chat message with “Guide,”, or ask about the server in ordinary chat and the Guide may answer: joining, the seals, shops, claims, skills, and your own stats. When it does not know, it says so instead of guessing, and unanswered questions are logged so its knowledge can grow. Type /guide off if you do not want it listening. Confirmed on a real phone (Bedrock) by Mike on October 18, the day it arrived; the new thinking answers meet their first real family questions this week.

title: Seal 1 and weekend bonus pages brought up to date (website only, not a server change). Upd
text:

Plugin list refreshed (website only, not a server change). Updated about 10:41 PM Central. The list now shows all 62 plugins running on the server, with versions checked in the start-up log, and the site assistant knows about tonight's changes.

The elite zombified piglin that used to trail behind its cousins has been fixed and now keeps pace. Still to check in game: the first doubled shower and the first elite skull, each one at a time.

Hit a zombie, husk, drowned, zombie villager or piglin — babies too — with an arrow, a thrown trident or a magic spell and it charges at half again its speed for about 3 seconds, refreshed by every new ranged hit. title: New: the Utility Pouch. You have a pouch now. Type /pouch or tap the Utility Pouch button
text:

Park the compass and the server stops handing you duplicates; what is parked stays parked even through death. ExcelPouch 0.1.0 is the pouch; ExcelMenuJoin 1.4.0 watches for parked compasses. Read the guide .
Difficulty flipped to Hard, on trial. At about 2:24 PM Central the valley's difficulty went from Normal to Hard in the Overworld, and the Nether and End were set and read back the same afternoon — a trial through the weekend, suggested by Jester, with the family's verdict on Monday, October 26.
Oct 18, 2026

The Five Seals table shows today's true numbers; Seals 1 and 2 keep everything else they promise, and the steps from Seal 3 on are unchanged. And if the wild ever feels too bold, this step can be turned back. Read The Five Seals .

title: New in the village: the Old Quartermaster, and he talks. A retired guild quartermaster now
text:
New in the village: the Old Quartermaster, and he talks. A retired guild quartermaster now stands in the spawn village with his lectern of tales beside him. He was the guild's quartermaster back when magic ran free and fed everything, monsters included, and his stories are the pre-seal lore of the guild: the five seals, the stronger monsters of his era, and the warning that the returning magic is stronger still. ExcelQuartermaster 0.1.0 makes him speak: tap him and he tells you the next tale, in order, remembered per player. He sells nothing. When the first seal falls, he is where the first wands are handed out. Still to check: the tap on a real phone (does the tale appear and the empty shop window stay shut?).
Installed live at about 2:39 AM Central: ExcelGuildGate 0.3.0, with the narrator. When a seal falls now, a recorded narrator voice line (the deep "Boomy Mountain" voice) plays for everyone online, and a short text guide follows in steps saying what opened. If you were offline when a seal fell, the beats you missed are told to you once on your next join (join catch-up). Java players are offered the narrator resource pack when they join; it is optional, and declining it changes nothing else. Bedrock hears the narrator too, through a Bedrock narrator pack served by Geyser (phone check pending). Admins can preview any seal with /guildgate narrate 1 to 5 . The campaign is untouched: still 0 of 5 seals, guild LOCKED. Still to check: hearing the narrator on a real phone.

Each fallen seal opens one stage (1 The Healer, 2 The Pathfinder, 3 Wonder, 4 The Masons, 5 The Schools), applied automatically by the bridge. It went in while the server was empty and was verified in the startup log and with permission probes: heal and cure both come back undefined for players, which is the dormancy proof.

Still to check: the prompts on a real phone or console (Bedrock tap check).
Server tuning finished at about 1:45 AM Central. The server optimization pass is complete: view distance 8, simulation distance 6, entity tracking ranges lowered, mob spawn range 6, monster cap 50, and chunks now send at up to 75 per second. The ViaVersion packet limiter is off, which ends the "too many packets" disconnects. Every value was verified in the live files after the restart.
Oct 17, 2026
New: the Skill Trees page. Every mcMMO perk (83 across 19 skills) with the exact level it unlocks on this server and how strong it is here, plus a sealed preview of the Magic skill tree that arrives as the Adventurers Guild seals fall. The game already announces each unlock in chat as you earn it; now the whole ladder is on the website too. Nothing on the server changed.
Installed live at 8:08 AM Central: ExcelTogether 0.3.0, the party range indicator. While you are in a party, the bar above your hotbar now shows whether party members are in bonus range: green "Party bonus ACTIVE: N in range (x1.25)" or dim "Party: nobody in range". Coming into range flashes "Party bonus ON" with a soft sound; leaving range flashes "Party bonus OFF". /excelparty cue off turns the flashes and sound off. It went in while the server was empty (two checks of 0 of 10 players), 492 of 492 automated tests pass, and the previous version is kept on the server as a backup for rollback. text:
Four plugins got our house names (renames only, nothing about how they work changed): ExcelWealthBoard 1.4.0 (was WealthBoard 1.3.0-mobile.7), ExcelWeekendXP 1.1.0 (was WeekendXP 1.0.2), ExcelNoPhantoms 1.1.0 (was NoPhantoms 1.0.0) and ExcelRestartCountdown 1.2.0 (was RestartCountdown 1.1.0). The welcome popup, the weekend and Together XP bonuses, the no-phantoms rule and the restart warnings all work as before. /restartwarn still works and /excelrestartwarn does the same thing; the restart permission accepts both the old and new name. None of the four had old data folders to carry over, so nothing needed migrating, and the old files are kept on the server as backups so any of them can be rolled back. Before install: 63 of 63 automated tests passed, two builds came out byte-for-byte identical, and test runs on a scratch server confirmed fresh install, both restart commands answering, and the weekend add-on working with our custom mcMMO. Still to check in real play: the welcome popup on a real join (Java and phone), phantom behavior over a few nights, and the weekend line at the first weekend boundary. Those are not confirmed yet. An earlier, never-installed RestartCountdown 1.1.1 draft was dropped; the live line came from 1.1.0. The source, tests and install records for all four are in an open draft record on GitHub: draft record PR #30 (still a draft).
The Adventurer's Guild is open: EliteMobs setup Phase 2 finished just after midnight on October 16, and the guild is the server's first big content launch. Type /ag to travel to the guild hall, its own separate world; the family world, your builds and your balances are untouched. Inside are NPCs including Casus the guide and Hermes the transporter , who sends you back to the exact spot you left. One quirk worth knowing before your first trip: EliteMobs teleports count down over a few seconds and cancel if you move , so stand still until you land (the owner interrupted two learning this). The guild's weapon shop opens and responds on a phone, and some shop categories stay locked until you earn guild ranks; those red crossed-out slots are normal for a new member. Behind the scenes, the plugin's first-time setup ran with the Recommended preset, which matches how the server already played, and installed the guild from the free package staged in imports on October 15 — no account or token was needed. Temporary operator access for the setup was granted by console and removed the same night, verified. Bedrock check passed by the owner in game (landing point, NPCs, transporter round trip, shop). Still to check in game: the guild on a Java client, the claim-safety test, and the Mossback roaming-boss spot check. If the family ever wants it gone, rollback is a three-step ladder from switching the package off to the verified pre-guild backup. Eight more free packs follow on the monthly plan, Steamworks next.
Updated ExcelBedrockMenu to 1.5.1 : the phone and console menu gains an Adventurers Guild button right after Spawn Shop. Tap it and it runs /ag for you, the same way the Spawn Shop button runs /shop , so Bedrock players can get to the guild hall from the menu instead of typing the command. The Java menu got the matching guild item at the same time (a bell in slot 12, tap to run /ag ). Only the menu changed; no data, balances, or other buttons moved, and the 1.5.0 jar is kept on the server as the rollback. Still to check in game: tapping the new button on a real phone or console and landing at the guild — that tap test has not been done yet.
The Road to the Guild is on: the Adventurer's Guild hall is built, but its door is now sealed until the family breaks all five seals together — the Ender Dragon, the Wither, an Elder Guardian, the Warden, and a raid victory. Progress is shared: a seal broken by anyone counts for everyone, and the campaign starts at 0 of 5 seals broken. Type /seals (or tap the new Road to the Guild button in the server menu) to see what remains. Until the last seal falls, the guild menu button wears a 🔒 lock, /ag and teleports into the guild world are blocked, and tapping the locked guild button shows the quest page instead. ExcelGuildGate 0.1.0 runs the seals and the quest page, and ExcelBedrockMenu 1.5.3 adds the Bedrock Road to the Guild button and the lock label; the Java menu gets the matching locked/open guild variants and a Road to the Guild item. Still to check in game: a real boss kill and a real raid victory breaking their seals on the live server, the /seals form on a real phone or console, the lock label on a real Bedrock client, the Java menu flipping to the open guild button after the last seal, and the gate stopping a real player who is not on the bypass list — none of those live checks had been done when this entry was prepared.
ExcelBedrockMenu 1.5.4: the server menu gains Server Commands and Server Website buttons on both menu styles. Server Commands opens a curated list of the server's 44 player commands in 7 groups — Getting Around, Money & Jobs, Skills & Levels, Shops & Trading, Claims & Land, Guild & Quests, Server Info — and most entries run their command with one tap; the ones that need more typing say so. You can also type /servercommands (or /cmds ) anywhere. Server Website shows this page's address; on Java it prints a clickable link, and on phones and consoles it shows the address to type, because Bedrock cannot open a browser from in game. The Java menu gets the two new items in slots 9 and 17 and a matching commands menu. Still to check in game: the commands and website forms on a real phone or console, and tapping the new Java menu items — those checks have not been done yet.
ExcelRewardGuard 1.2 is live, and the guard now has its own entry in the plugin list above (it ran behind the scenes, unlisted, until now). Farmed kills now also cover sky farms: a mob that took at least half its health from falling and is then finished by a player counts as farmed, so its Jobs money and mcMMO XP pay the same reduced 55% rate as spawner-farm kills. That is on top of the origin rules from 1.1 (spawners, spawn eggs, and Nether portals). Vanilla XP and item drops are never reduced, and EliteMobs rewards are logged only, never changed. Still to check in game: the acceptance checks, including a real session at a sky farm paying the reduced rate — that proof session has not happened yet.
